text:
Tara (Finance): following the postmortem, we need a compact remediation plan for the delayed-usage billing discrepancy. three lanes: eng fix + guard, billing corrections, and customer outreach. can owners confirm timelines here?

Ben (Eng): i'll take eng. early signal -> replayed event batches hitting meter twice during an overlap window. i'll produce a minimal repro, ship a small ingest dedupe (5s window) to canary, and add a CI replay regression. ETA for repro + canary: 2026-03-26 20:00 UTC.

Clara (Billing): i'll own invoice corrections. need a CSV of impacted request_ids with customer_id + invoice_id + token_delta. plan: map -> draft credit memos -> pilot 30 invoices -> full sweep. target pilot start 2026-03-30 AM.

Yusuf (Customer Ops): Support will prepare outbound templates and a triage sheet. need list of enterprise customers to pre-notify. will staff a shared inbox during pilot.

Tara (Finance): Ben please paste a short query/snippet to extract suspicious rows so billing can start mapping.

Ben (Eng): quick noisy query (non-PI):

```
SELECT request_id, customer_id, reported_tokens, estimated_tokens, reported_tokens - estimated_tokens AS delta
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_date = '2026-03-25' AND reported_tokens - estimated_tokens > 30
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 600;
```
I'll upload CSV to s3://incident-uploads/2499990001/impacted.csv after the repro run.

MeterBot: file_upload: s3://incident-uploads/2499990001/impacted.csv uploaded by @ben-eng at 2026-03-26T09:12:05Z; rows=214; size=48KB

Clara (Billing): received. quick policy question: for settled invoices do we refund or issue account credit? Tara, can finance confirm policy for this incident?

Tara (Finance): decision for this incident: refunds only on customer request AND amount > $600; otherwise apply account credit. enterprise customers get line-item invoice adjustments. please log policy in remediation notes.

Yusuf (Customer Ops): drafting two templates: (A) enterprise detailed notice w/ line-item breakdown, (B) general account-credit notice. i'll post drafts by 2026-03-27 12:00 PST.

Ben (Eng): short-term mitigation: 5s dedupe window at ingest + metric metering_duplicate_pct. will add a PagerDuty alert if daily duplicate pct > 0.25%. long-term: add idempotency keys to ingest producer.

Clara (Billing): initial mapping: ~76 invoices affected, 19 > $1k. estimated adj ~$13,450. will prep credit memos and schedule pilot for 2026-03-30 09:00 PST. posting owner+ETA in tracker shortly.

Tara (Finance): action log (brief):
- Ben (Eng): repro script, canary dedupe, CI replay regression, PD alert (due 2026-03-26 EOD)
- Clara (Billing): mapping, credit memos, pilot 2026-03-30 AM
- Yusuf (Customer Ops): comms templates + staffed inbox (draft 2026-03-27 12:00)

Tara (Finance): also request we add a weekly metering audit that compares reported_tokens vs model_estimate at invoice-level. Ben can you add a Grafana panel and a weekly job that flags invoice-level delta_rate > 0.5%?

Ben (Eng): yes, will add the panel and weekly job. posting alert rule link after deploy.

Clara (Billing): pilot scheduled. will post reconciliation CSV after run and open correction tickets in billing system.

Yusuf (Customer Ops): acknowledged. will start proactive outreach to enterprise customers after Clara confirms final list. will escalate refund requests > $600 to Tara.

Tara (Finance): thanks — i'll track in the remediation tracker and loop in legal if we see refund requests. please update this thread when tasks complete. :white_check_mark:
